note: What the homelands' level 3, 4 and 5 starter quests give each class (tools/quests/gen_homelands.py writes them into every home's quests as rewards.byclass): the class's own reward of the starting cities' class quest of that level, so a homeland's chain stands for the city's. Read off the Heirloom server's quests as they stood on 2026-11-10 (the rows, not the files: the rogue's level 5 is Shadowstrike there). L3 and L5 are the ability every city of the class teaches (a city that hands out a scroll of the same name teaches the same one: the spell is given here). L4 is the item most cities of the class give, the robe or the gloves for the cloth classes where the cities split between a robe and a staff (the human cities' choice). Two classes get nothing at level 4 in any city (the guides name no bow for the ranger, and the paladin's Footman's Longspear and Recruit's Shortsword are not records): they are given their class's own level 4-5 weapon here, the Glade Crafted Longbow (ranger only, level 4, as the druid's crafted glade staff) and the Sword of Faith (paladin only, level 5). Names are as the database spells them; a spell is its class's own record of the name (classspells: the warrior's Kick and the monk's are two).
